definition: קָמוֺן proper name, of a location Judg 10:5 , Παμνων , A Παμμω ( ᵐ5 L Καλκων ); in Gilead Jos Ant. see 7, 6 ( Καμων ); probably = Καμουν of Polyb see 70, 12 (named next after Πελλα ); Buhl Geogr. 256 thinks of †umêm, †amm (Schumacher Northern Ajlûn 137 f. ), between Jarmuk and Jabbok, west of Irbid .
